# FLX-3661: a response family has a malformed or repeated id

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A family's id is a lowercase letter followed by at most 127 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-' and '_', the grammar of a consumer query id, and it is unique across the families.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3661
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
